{
  "description": "A compatibility adapter for Self-EvolveRec diagnostics that preserves DiagnosisProbe(view, device) and run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), returning metrics and metric_definitions. Probes inspect the actual trained model through an architecture-compatible view and use only observed interaction histories, item titles, descriptions, and timestamps.",
  "motivation": "Keep diagnosis valid as the recommender architecture evolves, while maintaining a common evaluation protocol across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl. Avoid conclusions based on unavailable attributes or invented simulator traits.",
  "implementation_notes": "Preserve view.model, item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), user_train, meta_data, and review_data interfaces; adapt their implementations and probes to the trained architecture. The loader yields (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Missing review data must remain unavailable, not fabricated. Do not infer observed diversity or conformity traits. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per dataset. Select trials using macro-average validation HR@10 under the pinned evaluator, not the native HR@5/NDCG@5 combined score. Preserve dataset routing, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; keep artifacts beneath the trial directory.",
  "pseudocode": "class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device):
        store view and device

    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        initialize metrics and metric_definitions
        disable gradients:
            for _, sequence, positive, negative in train_loader:
                features = view.log2feats(sequence)
                score valid targets through view.predict_score
                accumulate supported model diagnostics, masking padding
            compute supported history and metadata diagnostics
            record unsupported probes as unavailable with reasons
            for each dataset:
                for each of five designated real training users:
                    score that dataset's full catalog
                    exclude padding and previously seen items
                    retain recommendations for simulator input
        restore model training state
        return metrics, metric_definitions

Trial selection: use host-computed macro validation HR@10.",
  "originality": {
    "score": 3,
    "positive": "Connects architecture-aware diagnosis with the native simulator and a shared benchmark objective.",
    "negative": "Primarily an interface and evaluation adaptation; it does not specify a new recommendation algorithm or diagnostic estimator."
  },
  "future_potential": {
    "score": 7,
    "positive": "Could support comparable, evidence-based diagnosis across evolving recommender architectures.",
    "negative": "Diagnostic usefulness and recommendation improvements require validation; unavailable user traits limit behavioral interpretation."
  },
  "code_difficulty": {
    "score": 6,
    "positive": "The fixed constructor, loader format, and compatibility view provide clear integration boundaries.",
    "negative": "Architecture changes require careful feature and scoring adaptation, padding masks, dataset isolation, and efficient full-catalog ranking."
  }
}
